echoParts: All Scripture is breathed out by God
that the man of God may be complete
verseText: All Scripture is breathed out by God and profitable for teaching, for reproof, for correction, and for training in righteousness, that the man of God may be complete, equipped for every good work.
meaning: The Bible comes from God. It helps us learn what is true, correct what is wrong, and grow in right living. By reading, believing, and following God's Word, we can be prepared for any good thing God wants us to do.
